posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md:
> **DannyBruza:** was this using the tape method of coating

yes it is ! i had great results . the overall thickness of the coating must be a little thinner than my #28 Meyer bar. danny what tape do you use ? i tryied the scotch tape (a little too thin), and then electrical tape (too heavy) ....... last night i was testing i piece of film about a week old and i noticed nonuniformities in color playback across the full hologram,for mastering it is a problem. 

i then shot my second test piece ,first

saturating it with high humidity ,1/2 hour before shooting and it seemd to even the playback nicely ! 

when i removed the film from the enviroment chamber (a plastic food dish with a wet towel on the bottom )the film was actually slighty sticky! LOL 

yum yum gummy-holos!
